name: Catty's Fishing Day 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Catty's Fishing Day is a clicker game where you embark on an exciting fishing journey filled with clicker mechanics, boss battles, and adorable ducks to aid you in catching the biggest fish! Discover new areas, upgrade your gear, and prepare for epic encounters with formidable Fish Bosses.
